name: Make M45A1 Great Again!
teaser: The Colt M45A1 pistol is an unpopular weapon, we must make it powerful!
description_html:
Change

1. Added fully automatic shooting mode (Remove single mode)

2. Moderately reduced some recoil

3. No no longer appears on Ragfair (Peacekeeper LL2)

Install

1. Unzip the mod

2. Move the folder to SPT_folder\user\mods

3. Done

By the way, this is a very basic mod. If you have never been exposed to mod creation, you can use this mod as a template to draw lessons and develop better mods
